measure.draft.summary: Compute a signed draft map from declared face samples (point + normal) under each pull direction; a pull wall (normal near-perpendicular to pull) must meet minDraft. Positive draft alone never proves demoldability.

inputs.faces: Nonempty array of {name?, point:[x,y,z], normal:[nx,ny,nz]} declared face samples (unit outward normal).
inputs.pullDirections: Nonempty array of {name?, axis:[x,y,z]} or bare [x,y,z] unit pull/ejection directions.
inputs.minDraft: Nonnegative angle, default 0 deg; pull walls must meet this magnitude.
inputs.pullWallWindow: Nonnegative angle, default 30 deg; faces with |signedDraft| within this of parallel are pull walls.
inputs.method: analytic (default); native B-Rep ray sampling is gated and rejected.

limitations: Computed from declared face samples, not native B-Rep rays. Positive draft alone never proves demoldability; parting lines, slides and mold flow are not solved.

measure.wall-map.summary: Map wall thickness from declared wall samples with explicit material continuity; an opposite point behind a void is void-backed and never reported as material thickness.

inputs.samples: Nonempty array of {name?, point:[x,y,z], opposite?:[x,y,z] | thickness?:length, continuity?:solid|void} wall samples.
inputs.minThickness: Nonnegative length, default 0 mm; solid samples thinner than this violate.
inputs.maxThickness: Optional length; solid samples thicker than this violate.
inputs.method: declared (default); native body ray sampling is gated and rejected.

limitations: Declared-sample wall thickness; native B-Rep ray sampling is gated. A void-backed opposite point is reported, not treated as material thickness. No mold-flow or CAE result is claimed.

undercut.check.summary: Detect directional undercuts: a face whose signed draft is more negative than the threshold locks the part in that pull direction.

inputs.faces: Nonempty array of {name?, point:[x,y,z], normal:[nx,ny,nz]} declared face samples.
inputs.pullDirections: Nonempty array of {name?, axis:[x,y,z]} or bare [x,y,z] unit pull directions.
inputs.undercutThreshold: Nonnegative angle, default 3 deg; signed draft below -threshold is an undercut.

limitations: Directional undercut from declared face normals only; slides, side actions and multi-axis molds are not solved. Positive draft alone never proves demoldability.

manufacturing.zone.summary: Define and validate manufacturing zones (a-surface, fit, seal, optical, parting, gate, ejector, weld, custom) with protection defaults and process/material/sampling metadata.

inputs.zones: Nonempty array of {name, kind, protected?, pullDirections?, minThickness?, maxThickness?, minDraft?} zone descriptors.
inputs.material: Optional material label; absence produces a warning.
inputs.sampling: Optional {method: declared|uniform|adaptive, tolerance?:length}; uniform/adaptive native sampling is gated.

limitations: Recipe zone metadata only; no native Fusion manufacturing feature is created. a-surface/seal/optical zones default to protected.

manufacturing.check.summary: Aggregate draft, wall-thickness and undercut checks against declared zones, and reject any global operation that touches a protected zone (seal, a-surface, optical).

inputs.zones: Nonempty array of zone descriptors (as manufacturing.zone).
inputs.faces: Nonempty array of declared face samples.
inputs.walls: Nonempty array of declared wall samples.
inputs.operations: Optional array of {name?, touches:[zoneName,...]} global operations; touching a protected zone violates.
inputs.minDraft: Optional minDraft for the draft check.
inputs.minThickness: Optional minThickness for the wall check.
inputs.maxThickness: Optional maxThickness for the wall check.

limitations: Aggregates declared-sample checks only. No CAE/mold-flow claim. Declared face refs are snapshots and must be revalidated after topology change.
